description: Box envelope (ECIES to a box) conformance vector. Every SDK seals `plaintext` to `recipient.agentPublicKey` under `info`, using `ephemeral.privateKeyHex` and `iv` instead of fresh randomness, and must produce `envelope` byte for byte. It must also open `envelope` with `recipient.privateKeyPkcs8Pem`, and fail to open it under `wrongInfo`. The scheme is packages/sandboxing/src/shared/helpers/BoxEnvelope.ts (sealBoxEnvelope) and apps/microvmd/src/helpers/BoxEnvelope.ts (openBoxEnvelope). The keys are test-only and protect nothing.

scheme.keyAgreement: ECDH P-256; the shared secret is the 32-byte x coordinate
scheme.kdf: HKDF-SHA256, salt = empty, info = UTF-8 `info`, length = 32
scheme.aead: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte iv, no AAD; ciphertext = encrypted bytes || 16-byte tag
scheme.encoding: ephemeralPublicKey = SPKI DER (uncompressed point); every envelope field is base64url without padding. agentPublicKey is SPKI DER in standard base64, as the API serves it
